title: Exploring the effects of mindfulness meditation on resting-state functional connectivity: an overview.
summary: Mindfulness meditation has received growing interest in research over the past decades. Mindfulness meditation training (MMT) can be employed as a mental practice to improve cognitive skills such as attention and emotion regulation and may promote well-being. Neuroimaging studies have emerged to understand the effects of MMT on brain functioning. However, no review exists on the effects of MMT on resting-state brain functional connectivity (rsFC) in healthy meditation-naïve adults specifically. We, therefore, aimed to provide an overview of studies that investigated the effects of MMT on rsFC in healthy meditation-naïve adults, as well as their link to cognitive and clinical measures. Several studies reported changes in MMT-induced rsFC within and between regions of the default mode (DMN), salience (SN), and central executive (CEN) networks. Both increases and decreases in rsFC have been observed for brain regions associated with these networks after MMT, each with differential roles in emotion regulation, stress, and cognitive functions. Some studies highlighted associations between changes in rsFC after MMT and modifications in cognitive performance and psycho-affective measures, which may be influenced by MMT-specific characteristics such as practice duration or delivery methods. MMT may induce a reorganization in the brain's functional architecture by altering rsFC within and between these networks and seems to modify processes related to attention, executive memory, emotional regulation, stress, and resilience. Investigating functional connectivity during rest in key brain networks seems a promising approach to understand the effects of mindfulness meditation on overall well-being.

标题：探索正念冥想对静息态功能连接的影响：一项综述
摘要：过去几十年来，正念冥想在研究领域受到越来越多的关注。正念冥想训练（MMT）可作为一种心理训练方法，用于改善注意力和情绪调节等认知技能，并可能促进幸福感。神经影像学研究不断涌现，旨在理解MMT对大脑功能的影响。然而，目前尚无专门针对MMT对健康且无冥想经验成年人静息态脑功能连接（rsFC）影响的综述。因此，我们旨在概述已发表的探讨MMT对健康无冥想经验成年人rsFC影响的研究，以及这些影响与认知和临床测量指标之间的关联。多项研究报告了MMT诱导的默认模式网络（DMN）、突显网络（SN）和中央执行网络（CEN）内部及网络间rsFC的变化。MMT后，与这些网络相关的大脑区域rsFC既观察到升高也观察到降低，各自在情绪调节、压力和认知功能中发挥不同作用。部分研究强调了MMT后rsFC变化与认知表现和心理情感测量指标改变之间的关联，这些关联可能受到MMT特定特征（如练习时长或实施方式）的影响。MMT可能通过改变这些网络内部及网络间的rsFC，诱导大脑功能架构的重组，并似乎会改变与注意力、执行记忆、情绪调节、压力和心理韧性相关的过程。研究关键大脑网络在静息状态下的功能连接，似乎是理解正念冥想对整体幸福感影响的一个有前景的方法。
关键词：正念冥想；静息态功能连接；情绪调节；默认模式网络；认知功能
